title: Evaluation of the generator polynomial
statement: Let $\ell,n\in\mathbb N$, let a certified binary field implementation of degree $\ell$ be given, and let $\gamma$ be a binary vector of length $n$. For every element $r$ of the field extension defined by its irreducible modulus, evaluating the generator polynomial associated with $\gamma$ at $r$ gives $\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}\gamma_i r^{i+1}$, where each coefficient acts on the power by scalar multiplication.
hypotheses_covered: A certified binary field implementation of degree $\ell$
An element $r$ of the field extension defined by the implementation's modulus
